d:
Back at it again! Now this is interesting, because I've been uploading Almarossa's doujins since 2019, and he usually does twice a year. Once around April-March and then October-November. I guess he's experimenting with releases? Or the transsexual doujin did not do good? On both DLSite and Fanza it's among the lowest sales. The eleventh installment is already at 950 units sold on Fanza since June 20. The transexual doujin was released in March. Anyways, finally got some progress. With the series hitting nine years this year, I guess either a wrap up this year or next year. It's been... Well, meh. When I think about it, could've wrapped this around chapter 5. While it was supposed to be a slow corruption, he just repeated much of the same points. Granted we haven't gotten high-quality translation for this series and Almarossa for a while.

Anyways, enjoy!
